project_type: Python monorepo — FastAPI API gateway + Temporal worker + MCP tool server + synthetiq-shared package
build_system: hatchling per-package (worker, api, mcp each have their own pyproject.toml). No top-level build step. Dependencies installed via pip or uv into each package venv.
test_framework: pytest. Worker tests go under worker/tests/. Run with: cd worker && python -m pytest tests/ -v
build_command: No compile step. Import smoke-test: cd worker && python -c 'import sys; sys.path.insert(0,"src"); from activities.agent_activities import audit_scada_telemetry_activity; print("ok")'
verification_instructions: 1. For each changed Python module: cd worker && python -c 'import sys; sys.path.insert(0,"src"); from <module> import *; print(ok)' — must print ok with no errors. 2. For alembic migrations: cd packages/synthetiq-shared && alembic upgrade head — must complete without error. 3. For MCP tools: cd mcp && python -c 'import asyncio; from src.tools.gst_tool import gst_tool; r = asyncio.run(gst_tool.verify_bill("EWB-T")); assert r["status"]=="UNVERIFIED" and "cryptographic_proof" not in r; print(ok)'. 4. Privacy unit test: cd worker && python -m pytest tests/test_privacy.py -v.
environment_constraints: Windows workspace (PowerShell). Worker sys.path has worker/src prepended at runtime (see worker/src/main.py line 10). All intra-worker imports use bare names (e.g. 'from agents.privacy import scrub', NOT 'from src.agents.privacy import scrub'). Alembic env is in packages/synthetiq-shared/alembic/. Do NOT restart any running dev server or push to remote.
contribution_requirements: No AGENTS.md found. Follow existing code style: from __future__ import annotations at top, type annotations on all public functions, Pydantic BaseModel for result types, ApplicationError for fail-closed gates, logger = logging.getLogger(__name__) in each module.
key_patterns: Activities return typed Pydantic model dicts via .model_dump(). Agents are in worker/src/agents/ and each expose a run_<name>_agent() async coroutine. All ORM models live in packages/synthetiq-shared/synthetiq_shared/models/organization.py (single file). DB access uses 'async with get_db_session() as session'. Alembic revision IDs are hex strings in filenames. RunConfig.pack and RunConfig.calibrations are the canonical source of runtime parameters in workflows.
